name: aiprise
label: AiPrise
description: KYC, KYB, and fraud prevention platform — verify user identities, onboard businesses, run AML/sanctions checks, and detect fraud signals.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Your AiPrise API key. Log in to your AiPrise dashboard, go to **Settings > API Keys** and copy it.

environment.label: Environment
environment.description: Select the AiPrise environment to use.

run_user_verification_profile.label: Start Identity Verification
run_user_verification_profile.description: Kicks off a new identity check for a person. AiPrise will run the checks defined in your chosen template (e.g. ID document scan, liveness, address).

template_id.label: Verification Template
template_id.description: Which set of checks to run. To find this: log in to AiPrise → go to **Templates** → open the template you want → copy the **Template ID** shown at the top of the page.

user_profile_id.label: User Profile ID
user_profile_id.description: The ID of the user profile to verify. You can get this from the output of the **Create User Profile** action.

get_verification_url.label: Get Identity Verification Link
get_verification_url.description: Generates a secure link you can send to a person so they can complete their identity verification on an AiPrise-hosted page — no extra development needed.

template_id.label: Verification Template
template_id.description: Which set of checks the person will go through. To find this: log in to AiPrise → go to **Templates** → open the template you want → copy the **Template ID** shown at the top of the page.

redirect_uri.label: Redirect URL
redirect_uri.description: The page the person will be sent to after they finish the verification on the AiPrise-hosted form.

get_verification_result.label: Get Identity Verification Result
get_verification_result.description: Fetches the current status and outcome of a person's identity check — whether it is still in progress, approved, or declined.

session_id.label: Verification Session ID
session_id.description: The ID of the verification to look up. You can get this from the output of the **Start Identity Verification** action, or from the **session_id** field in any webhook payload from AiPrise.

get_user_input_data.label: Get Person's Submitted Verification Data
get_user_input_data.description: Returns the information the person entered and the documents they uploaded during their identity check (e.g. name, date of birth, ID document details).

session_id.label: Verification Session ID
session_id.description: The ID of the verification to retrieve data from. You can get this from the output of the **Start Identity Verification** action, or from the **session_id** field in any webhook payload from AiPrise.

update_verification_result.label: Override Identity Verification Decision
update_verification_result.description: Manually changes the outcome of an identity check — useful when a human reviewer needs to approve or decline a case that AiPrise flagged for manual review.

session_id.label: Verification Session ID
session_id.description: The ID of the verification whose decision you want to change. You can get this from the output of the **Start Identity Verification** action, or from the **session_id** field in any webhook payload from AiPrise.

result.label: New Decision
result.description: The outcome you want to set. Choose **Approved** to pass the person, **Declined** to reject them, **Review** to put the case back into manual review, or **Deactivated** to deactivate the profile.

run_business_verification.label: Start Business Verification
run_business_verification.description: Kicks off a company background check. AiPrise will run the checks defined in your template — which can include company registry lookup, ownership structure (UBO), sanctions screening, and adverse media.

template_id.label: Verification Template
template_id.description: Which set of checks to run on the business. To find this: log in to AiPrise → go to **Templates** → open the template you want → copy the **Template ID** shown at the top of the page.

business_profile_id.label: Business Profile ID
business_profile_id.description: The ID of the business profile you want to verify. This is returned when you create a business profile.

get_business_verification_result.label: Get Business Verification Result
get_business_verification_result.description: Fetches the current status and outcome of a company's background check — whether it is still running, approved, or declined.

session_id.label: Verification Session ID
session_id.description: The ID of the business verification to look up. You can get this from the output of the **Start Business Verification** action, or from the **session_id** field in any webhook payload from AiPrise.

get_business_input_data.label: Get Business's Submitted Verification Data
get_business_input_data.description: Returns the company information provided during a business verification — such as company name, registration number, directors, and ownership details.

session_id.label: Verification Session ID
session_id.description: The ID of the business verification to retrieve data from. You can get this from the output of the **Start Business Verification** action, or from the **session_id** field in any webhook payload from AiPrise.

run_document_check.label: Run Business Document Check
run_document_check.description: Runs a verification check on a document belonging to an existing business profile. AiPrise will process the uploaded file against the checks defined in the chosen template.

business_profile_id.label: Business Profile ID
business_profile_id.description: The ID of the business profile the document belongs to. You can find this in AiPrise → **Businesses** → open the business → copy the **Profile ID**.

template_id.label: Verification Template
template_id.description: Which set of checks to run. To find this: log in to AiPrise → go to **Templates** → open the template you want → copy the **Template ID** shown at the top of the page.

file_uuid.label: File UUID
file_uuid.description: The UUID of the document file that was previously uploaded to AiPrise.

document_input_title.label: Document Input Title
document_input_title.description: An optional unique identifier for this document input. This value is included in webhook payloads and API responses so you can distinguish between multiple documents.

client_reference_id.label: Client Reference ID
client_reference_id.description: Your own identifier to associate with this request — for example an order number or internal case ID.

client_reference_data.label: Client Reference Data
client_reference_data.description: Any additional JSON data you want to store alongside this request.

create_business_profile.label: Create Business Profile
create_business_profile.description: Creates a new business profile in AiPrise. The returned profile can then be used to run document checks or other business verifications.

name.label: Business Name
name.description: The business name. The legal name is preferred.

alternate_name.label: Alternate Name (DBA)
alternate_name.description: An alternate "doing business as" name, if any.

tax_identification_number.label: Tax Identification Number
tax_identification_number.description: The tax ID for this business (e.g. EIN in the US).

formation_date.label: Formation Date
formation_date.description: The date the business was formed, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

country_code.label: Country Code
country_code.description: The 2-letter ISO country code where the business is registered (e.g. US, GB).

state_code.label: State/Province Code
state_code.description: The state or province code where the business is registered (e.g. CA, NY).

business_entity_id.label: Business Entity ID
business_entity_id.description: A government-issued entity identifier for this business.

addresses.label: Addresses
addresses.description: A JSON array of address objects (address_street_1, address_street_2, address_city, address_state, address_zip_code, address_country).

phone_numbers.label: Phone Numbers
phone_numbers.description: One or more phone numbers associated with the business.

email_addresses.label: Email Addresses
email_addresses.description: One or more email addresses associated with the business.

additional_information.label: Additional Information
additional_information.description: A JSON array of supporting documents or extra data for this business.

client_reference_id.label: Client Reference ID
client_reference_id.description: Your own internal identifier for this business.

callback_url.label: Callback URL
callback_url.description: A webhook URL that AiPrise will call with verification results.

events_callback_url.label: Events Callback URL
events_callback_url.description: A webhook URL that AiPrise will call with event notifications.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tag names used to categorize this business profile.

create_business_profile.beforeRequest: for (const key of Object.keys(request.body)) if (Array.isArray(request.body[key]) && request.body[key].length === 0 && key !== 'additional_information') delete request.body[key]; return request;

create_user_profile.label: Create User Profile
create_user_profile.description: Creates a new user profile in AiPrise. The returned profile can then be used for repeated verifications or ongoing monitoring for the same person.

second_last_name.label: Second Last Name
second_last_name.description: User's second surname, where applicable (e.g. in some Latin American naming conventions).

full_name.label: Full Name
full_name.description: The complete name. Use this if you do not have the name split into parts.

date_of_birth.label: Date of Birth
date_of_birth.description: User's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.

client_reference_id.label: Client Reference ID
client_reference_id.description: Your own internal identifier for this user.

events_callback_url.label: Events Callback URL
events_callback_url.description: A webhook URL that AiPrise will call with event notifications for this profile.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tag names used to categorize this user profile. Tags are created if they do not already exist.

create_user_profile.beforeRequest: if (Object.keys(request.body.address || {}).length === 0) delete request.body.address; if (Array.isArray(request.body.tags) && request.body.tags.length === 0) delete request.body.tags; return request;

get_user_profile.label: Get User Profile
get_user_profile.description: Fetches a user profile from AiPrise by its ID — including the person's stored details, tags, linked verification sessions, and metadata.

user_profile_id.label: User Profile ID
user_profile_id.description: The ID of the user profile to retrieve. You can get this from the output of the **Create User Profile** action, or from the `user_profile_id` field in any webhook payload from AiPrise.

get_business_profile.label: Get Business Profile
get_business_profile.description: Fetches a business profile from AiPrise by its ID — including the stored company details, addresses, tags, linked verification sessions, and metadata.

business_profile_id.label: Business Profile ID
business_profile_id.description: The ID of the business profile to retrieve. You can get this from the output of the **Create Business Profile** action, or from the `business_profile_id` field in any webhook payload from AiPrise.

search_businesses.label: Search Businesses
search_businesses.description: Searches public business registries by name and country, returning a list of matching companies with their entity IDs, types, and addresses.

name.label: Business Name
name.description: The business name to search for. Partial matches are supported by AiPrise.

country_code.label: Country Code
country_code.description: 2-letter ISO country code where the business is registered (e.g. US, GB).

state_code.label: State/Province Code
state_code.description: Optional state or province code to narrow the search (e.g. CA, NY for the US). Leave empty to search the whole country.

get_additional_user_info.label: Get Person's Additional Info
get_additional_user_info.description: Fetches supplementary information collected from the person during a verification — anything beyond the primary identity fields, such as follow-up answers, extra documents, or custom form data.

session_id.label: Verification Session ID
session_id.description: The ID of the verification to look up. You can get this from the output of the **Start Identity Verification** action.

get_business_documents.label: Get Business Documents
get_business_documents.description: Lists all documents attached to a business profile — including file UUIDs, names, S3 URLs, timestamps, document sources, and associated verification sessions.

business_profile_id.label: Business Profile ID
business_profile_id.description: The ID of the business profile whose documents you want to list. You can get this from the output of the **Create Business Profile** action.
